summary: Master agricultural credit risk, emerging cash crop appraisal, and IFRS 9 compliance. Professional training for agri-lenders and risk managers. Enroll today.
lede: Agriculture lending for emerging cash crops involves assessing crop viability, cash flows and credit risks before structuring finance. This training is for financial services and agribusiness professionals who underwrite or manage agricultural credit, and develops skills in evaluating agronomic and market risks, modeling seasonal repayments and assessing portfolio exposure. Learners also practice valuing biological assets, structuring collateral and monitoring loans with early-warning indicators.
audienceIntro: This program is curated for mid-to-senior level professionals within the financial services and agribusiness sectors who require advanced technical competencies in agricultural credit risk and portfolio management.
modules: Agricultural Finance Fundamentals and Market Dynamics
Technical Appraisal of Emerging Cash Crops
Credit Risk Management and IFRS 9 Integration
Collateral Management and Biological Asset Valuation
Digital Transformation and AgTech in Lending
Structured Value Chain and Trade Finance
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in credit analysis, commercial lending, or agribusiness management. Familiarity with basic financial statements (balance sheet, P&L) and Microsoft Excel is required for the modeling exercises.
